text:
The clinical picture of prematurity, C-section delivery, and the chest X-ray findings of a ground-glass appearance with air bronchograms are classic for Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS). The normal blood glucose makes Transient Tachypnea of the Newborn (TTN) less likely. Please confirm if there is a specific family history of surfactant protein deficiency or pulmonary hypoplasia, as this would alter the management significantly.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS)
